description: Get an indicative price for extending a Guard to a later settlement date. Use it when a customer asks what it costs to extend a Guard. Returns: extensionCost, what the customer pays to extend, in the home currency. Show it as the answer: "Extending to [date] costs [extensionCost]". It is one figure; there is no breakdown. Also the currencies, the direction, the foreign amount, both dates, valid, errors, stale. Both dates are moved to the next business day when needed, and a note says so. Parameters: guardCurrency, foreignCurrency, payReceive, foreignAmount, originalSettlementDate, extendedSettlementDate. There is no Guard rate input: the server prices the extension at today's market rate, not at the rate of the Guard the customer holds. Say that the figure is indicative for that reason too.

extendedSettlementDate.description: Extended (new) settlement date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD

foreignAmount.description: Amount in foreign currency to protect

foreignCurrency.description: Foreign currency ISO code, e.g. USD

guardCurrency.description: Home/base currency ISO code, e.g. GBP

originalSettlementDate.description: Original settlement date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD

payReceive.description: PAY if paying foreign currency, RECEIVE if receiving it

name: price_guard_extension
title: Price Guard Extension
